_doc: One entry per clip (DESIGN 6.5). clip: the clip id = the file name and SettingsDial.Explainer (the dial id unless shared). dial: the registry id `setting id=` writes. kind: state (before value, the change, after value), motion (the dial at `value` while `action` plays; `takes` for more than one), diagram (a sound dial: `diagram` names the drawing, in the theme's colours read from the app). themes: "all" or a list (theme options only in their theme). w, h, scale, route, mountArgs, setup: the surface (the mount, extra mount args, inspector lines run after the mount). before/after: dial values (a choice's index, a toggle's true|false, a slider's number; after may be a list of steps, each held). sweep: seconds to move a slider from before to after through its values. region: what to crop: keys (node keys from `find`, `key#n` for the nth match; their union over both states) or rect [x,y,w,h] DIP; pad; fit contain|width|height; focus (a key the crop centres on); anchor left|right|top|bottom (hold the crop to that edge of the union); clamp "keys" (stay inside the union); within (a key or rect the crop stays inside where it fits, e.g. shell.content.card); minWidth (DIP, default 320 = 640 px at scale 2); dx/dy. Any field, and any region field, may be a dict keyed by theme ({"winui": ..., "default": ...}). Timing: step (engine frames per capture, 16 ms each), capture (max seconds of change), stillFrames, watch ("region": judge stillness on the region keys, not the window), rest (frames after the settle), hold (s), quality (where the encode starts; dim text on a dim ground wants more than 70: lossy smears it into a blur of its own), slow (motion slowed for legibility), maxStill (s: a still stretch inside the change is cut to this, e.g. a start delay), fps. pending: {branch, part, why}: part surface (the surface is on another branch) or inspector (the headless inspector cannot stage it yet) is skipped until it lands (--pending tries it); part dial (the dial is on another branch) is recorded at the build's default when withoutDial is "record". sharedWith: dials whose badge shows this clip. todo: what to settle when the entry is recorded for the first time.
